title: Growing and Harvesting Electro Competent E-coli Cells
author: Leo Blondel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gc7bszn

steps.title: Prepare SOB medium
steps.instruction: Make 1 L of SOB by adding 20 g tryptone (2 % w/v), 5 g yeast extract (0.5 % w/v), 0.5 g NaCl (8.56 mM) **or** 0.584 g NaCl (10 mM), 0.186 g KCl (2.5 mM), and de‑ionized water to a final volume of 1000 mL; then add 0.952 g anhydrous MgCl₂ (10 mM) and 2.467 g MgSO₄·7H₂O (10 mM).

steps.title: Inoculate overnight culture
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony from a fresh plate of the desired strain, inoculate into 10 mL SOB in a 125 mL flask, and incubate 16–18 h at 37 °C with shaking at 250 rpm.

steps.title: Inoculate main cultures
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm two 1 L glass flasks each containing 250 mL SOB to 37 °C; add 5 mL (2 % inoculum) of the overnight culture to each flask.

steps.title: Grow to mid‑log and prep equipment
steps.instruction: Shake the flasks at 37 °C, 250 rpm until the cultures reach an OD₆₀₀ of 0.5–0.7. Meanwhile, turn on the centrifuge and cool the rotor to 4 °C, and place 1 L of 10 % glycerol on ice.

steps.title: Chill cultures and transfer
steps.instruction: Place the cultures on ice for 15 min, keep them ice‑cold thereafter, and pour each 250 mL culture into a chilled 500 mL (or 1000 mL) centrifuge bottle.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the bottles at 5000 rpm for 10 min, then pour off the supernatant and aspirate any residual broth.

steps.title: First glycerol wash
steps.instruction: Add 250 mL ice‑cold glycerol to each bottle and resuspend the cells completely by pipetting up and down; centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 10 min; pour off the supernatant (aspiration not required).

steps.title: Second glycerol wash and final resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 250 mL ice‑cold glycerol; centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 10 min; pour off the supernatant and resuspend the cells in the residual glycerol by pipetting up and down.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 250 mL ice‑cold glycerol.
Resuspend cells in the remaining glycerol by pipetting up/down.

steps.title: Aliquot and freeze cells
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of the final cell suspension into chilled Eppendorf tubes on ice; place the tubes on dry ice for 10 min, then transfer to a –80 °C freezer. Cells remain viable for >6 months.
